claim: One portable project-approach owner preserves project-stage evidence, comparables, cost/vendor reality, a ranked recommendation, failure conditions, and next actions with self-contained cross-host fallbacks and optional host-native accelerators.

portable_behavior_migrated: pre-build, mid-build, and post-build project modes
official pricing/limits and prototype-launch-growth cost framing
two-to-four viable paths with one recommendation and strongest alternative
failure/reopening condition and ordered implementation path
routed_to_existing_owners: intent reconstruction and material decision trace to outcome-first-workflow-design
genuinely new architecture prior art to neuroarxiv
difficult discovery may use iterative-blind-research when present, with a self-contained fallback on other hosts
implemented-change review uses each host and repository's native tests/build/review path; Hermes may use code-change-verification
domain decisions to their domain owners
discarded: duplicated generic safety and permission prose
large fixed report templates and repeated conclusions

verification.candidate_invariants: all project modes, comparables, cost, one recommendation, failure condition, next actions, and owner routes present
verification.source_bundles: Hermes, Codex, and OMP bundles were byte-identical before synthesis

limits: Fresh shared deployment and host discovery are required before source copies are removed.
